questions.question: Briefly explain the preparation of traditional Indian sweets like peda and / burfi.
questions.solution_html:
• Briefly explain the preparation of traditional Indian sweets like peda and burfi.
  • Peda:- Broken the Koha into bits, Mix with sugar, Put into a Pan and cook over a
  • very slow fire, pour into a greased tray. After cool and set, cut into desired size and
  • shape. Burfi:- 4 to 5 litres of buffalo milk is heated in a stainless-steel kettle with
  • constant stirring to prevent scorching. When semisolid consistency is reached, stop
  • heating, and add powdered sugar, mix well using a wooden ladle until uniform
  • smooth mass is formed. Then, pour the mixture into a greased tray. After cool and
  • set, cut into desired size and shape.
  • (Preparation of Peda-(1.5 marks) and Preparation of Burfi- (1.5 marks)).
questions.final_answer: (Preparation of Peda- and Preparation of Burfi- )
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Define prepared meat products with two examples
questions.solution_html:
• Prepared meat or processed meat products are any meats that have been modified
  • from their fresh state to either improve their flavor or extend their shelf life (through
  • multiple processing steps). Examples: Meatballs, Sausages, Bacon (made from pork
  • belly or the back of the pig), deli meats, pre-cooked roasts, meat pies, ready-meals
  • containing meat.
  • (Definition- (1 Mark), Any two examples- (2 Marks) ((1 mark) each)

questions.question: Compare the storage requirements of liquid, frozen, and powdered / eggs.
questions.solution_html:
• Compare the storage requirements of liquid, frozen, and powdered eggs.
  • Liquid Eggs:- Packaged in cartons, plastic pouches, or bulk containers, then
  • refrigerated at 0 to 40C. Frozen Eggs:- Stored in containers (eg. Pails, drums) in
  • freezers at -180C or lower. Powdered Eggs:- Packaged in moisture -proof, airtight
  • containers (eg. Bags, drums, nitrogen-flushed pouches) to prevent oxidation and
  • moisture absorption. Stored in cool, dry condition at below 200C. ((1 Mark) for each
  • liquid, frozen, and powdered eggs)
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Define 'Chakka' and mention its role in Srikhand preparation.
questions.solution_html:
• Chakka (strained yogurt) is a semi-solid, concentrated milk product obtained by
  • partially or completely draining the whey from plain dahi or yogurt. It has a smooth
  • uniform, semi-solid consistency and is typically white to pale yellow in color. Chakka is
  • the primary and base ingredient for the preparation of the Shrikhand, which is a
  • semi-soft, concentrated, sweetish-sour form of fermented milk. (Definition- (1.5 Marks)
  • mentioning role in Srikhand- (1.5 Marks))
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: How is wort fermented for preparing Honey beer?
questions.solution_html:
• Honey beer preparation begins with the preparation of wort by boiling barley malt and
  • hops to extract fermentable sugars and flavor. To ferment wort for honey beer, the hot
  • wort is first cooled and then honey is added. Then, yeast is added for fermentation (7
  • to 14 days).
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: What is beeswax?
questions.solution_html:
• Beeswax is a natural wax produced by honeybees by using their four pairs of wax
  • glands situated on the anterior part of the worker’s last four normal sternal plates.
  • Bees secrete it as a liquid that hardens into scales upon contact with air, and they use
  • these scales to build the hexagonal cells of their honeycomb. It is composed mainly of
  • esters of fatty acids and long-chain alcohols, free fatty acids, hydrocarbons and other
  • minor components (eg. Carotenoids, propolis etc.). (Definition-(2 Marks)
  • Composition- (1 mark))
  • State why deoiling is required in the production of fish silage from oily fishes.
questions.final_answer: State why deoiling is required in the production of fish silage from oily fishes
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Explain the methods of extraction and preservation of fish glue.
questions.solution_html:
• Fish glue is a protein-based adhesive made from collagen extracted from fish
  • by-products like skin, bones, and swim bladders. Methods of Extraction:-Raw
  • Material Preparation, Pre-treatment (Soaking and Cleaning), Heating/Decoction
  • Filtration, Concentration and Drying. Methods of Preservation:- Drying, Chemical
  • Preservation, Low-Temperature Storage. (Extraction- (2.5 Marks), Preservation- 2.5
  • Marks)

questions.question: Explain the process of honey production in honeybees.
questions.solution_html:
• Honeybees collect nectar from flowers, storing in stomach where enzymes begin to
  • convert it into honey, deposit the partially-transformed nectar into honeycomb cells
  • fan it with their wings to evaporate excess water until it becomes thick honey, which
  • is then sealed with a wax cap. ((1 Mark) to each step)
questions.final_answer: is then sealed with a wax cap. ( to each step)

questions.question: Describe the preservation techniques used in RTC & RTE products
questions.solution_html:
• Preservation Techniques for Ready-to-Cook (RTC) Products
  • Refrigeration/Chilling, Washing and Sanitation, Adding antimicrobial agents
  • Modified Atmosphere Packaging (MAP), Irradiation, Freezing or Dehydration, or
  • Drying. Preservation Techniques for Ready-to-Eat (RTE) Products: - thermal
  • sterilization, Modified Atmosphere Packaging (MAP), High-Pressure Processing
  • (HPP), Rapid Freezing, adding approved chemical preservatives, Vacuum Cooling
  • or Packaging. (Liberal Valuation, RTC- (2.5 Marks), RTE- (2.5 Marks))
  • 6/6
